Returns one exact Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge profile with policies, source template, assignment, ConfigContext state, and supported related configuration. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations, profiles, vNICs/vHBAs, chassis IOMs, child switches, and server storage. Exact OData organization/profile resolution and every helper/HTTP response are validated; incomplete IOM data fails closed. Server I/O combines direct profile and LAN/SAN policy lookups and deduplicates by Moid. Disk inventory is returned only when requested and an Assigned/Associated server exists; it is hardware inventory, not profile configuration. Chassis IOM/controller calls use combined exact-Moid filters. Success returns validated data without mutation. vNIC, vHBA, disk, and contained-server traversal is intentionally omitted for non-Server routes in v1.

properties.description: Parses the exactly matched profile, retains the full profile, PolicyBucket, SrcTemplate, assignment, and ConfigContext, validates route identity and relationship integrity, rejects conflicting assignment relationships, builds combined server I/O filters for the profile plus referenced LAN/SAN connectivity policies, captures referenced IOM profiles, and builds the assigned-server storage-controller filter.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
profileType = sys.argv[2]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[3]
expectedTargetPlatform = sys.argv[4]
results = payload.get("Results")
if not isinstance(results, list) or len(results) != 1 or not isinstance(results[0], dict):
    raise ValueError("Expected exactly one profile result")
profile = results[0]
profileMoid = profile.get("Moid") or ""
profileObjectType = profile.get("ObjectType") or ""
targetPlatform = profile.get("TargetPlatform") or ""
policyBucket = profile.get("PolicyBucket")
if policyBucket is None:
    policyBucket = []
if not isinstance(policyBucket, list):
    raise ValueError("PolicyBucket must be an array or null")
srcTemplate = profile.get("SrcTemplate")
configContext = profile.get("ConfigContext")

def relationship(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or not value.get("Moid") or not value.get("ObjectType"):
        raise ValueError("Relationships must include Moid and ObjectType")
    return value

if srcTemplate is not None:
    srcTemplate = relationship(srcTemplate)
if configContext is not None and not isinstance(configContext, dict):
    raise ValueError("ConfigContext must be an object or null")

def unique_relationships(values):
    answer = []
    seen = set()
    for value in values:
        rel = relationship(value)
        if not rel:
            continue
        key = (rel.get("Moid", ""), rel.get("ObjectType", ""))
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            answer.append(rel)
    return answer

def odata(value):
    return str(value).replace("'", "''")

profileTypeValid = profileObjectType == expectedObjectType and (not expectedTargetPlatform or targetPlatform == expectedTargetPlatform)
assignment = None
serverAssigned = False
assignmentValid = True
assignedServerMoid = ""
assignedServerObjectType = ""
if profileType == "Server":
    assignments = unique_relationships([profile.get("AssignedServer"), profile.get("AssociatedServer")])
    if len(assignments) > 1:
        assignmentValid = False
    if assignments:
        assignment = assignments[0]
        serverAssigned = True
        assignedServerMoid = assignment.get("Moid") or ""
        assignedServerObjectType = assignment.get("ObjectType") or ""
        assignmentValid = assignmentValid and assignedServerObjectType in ("compute.Blade", "compute.RackUnit")
elif profileType == "Chassis":
    assignments = unique_relationships([profile.get("AssignedChassis"), profile.get("AssociatedChassis")])
    assignmentValid = len(assignments) <= 1
    assignment = assignments[0] if assignments else None
else:
    assignment = relationship(profile.get("AssignedEntity"))

lanPolicyMoids = []
sanPolicyMoids = []
for rel in policyBucket:
    if not isinstance(rel, dict) or not rel.get("Moid") or not rel.get("ObjectType"):
        raise ValueError("PolicyBucket entries must include Moid and ObjectType")
    moid = rel["Moid"]
    objectType = rel["ObjectType"]
    if moid and objectType == "vnic.LanConnectivityPolicy" and moid not in lanPolicyMoids:
        lanPolicyMoids.append(moid)
    if moid and objectType == "vnic.SanConnectivityPolicy" and moid not in sanPolicyMoids:
        sanPolicyMoids.append(moid)

ethernetTerms = ["Profile.Moid eq '%s'" % odata(profileMoid)]
ethernetTerms.extend("LanConnectivityPolicy.Moid eq '%s'" % odata(moid) for moid in lanPolicyMoids)
fibreChannelTerms = ["Profile.Moid eq '%s'" % odata(profileMoid)]
fibreChannelTerms.extend("SanConnectivityPolicy.Moid eq '%s'" % odata(moid) for moid in sanPolicyMoids)
ethernetInterfaceFilter = "(" + " or ".join(ethernetTerms) + ")"
fibreChannelInterfaceFilter = "(" + " or ".join(fibreChannelTerms) + ")"
interfaceFiltersReady = profileType != "Server" or bool(profileMoid and ethernetInterfaceFilter and fibreChannelInterfaceFilter)

iomRelationships = profile.get("IomProfiles")
if iomRelationships is None:
    iomRelationships = []
if not isinstance(iomRelationships, list):
    raise ValueError("IomProfiles must be an array or null")
iomProfileMoids = []
for rel in iomRelationships:
    if not isinstance(rel, dict) or not rel.get("Moid") or rel.get("ObjectType") != "chassis.IomProfile":
        raise ValueError("IomProfiles entries must be chassis.IomProfile relationships with Moid")
    moid = rel["Moid"]
    if moid not in iomProfileMoids:
        iomProfileMoids.append(moid)
iomProfileReferenceCount = len(iomProfileMoids)
iomProfileFilter = "(" + " or ".join("Moid eq '%s'" % odata(moid) for moid in iomProfileMoids) + ")" if iomProfileMoids else ""
iomProfileFilterReady = not iomProfileMoids or bool(iomProfileFilter)

controllerFilter = ""
if serverAssigned and assignmentValid:
    relationshipName = "ComputeBlade" if assignedServerObjectType == "compute.Blade" else "ComputeRackUnit"
    controllerFilter = "%s.Moid eq '%s'" % (relationshipName, odata(assignedServerMoid))

profileJson = json.dumps(profile, separators=(",", ":"))
policyBucketJson = json.dumps(policyBucket, separators=(",", ":"))
sourceTemplateJson = json.dumps(srcTemplate, separators=(",", ":"))
assignmentJson = json.dumps(assignment, separators=(",", ":"))
configContextJson = json.dumps(configContext, separators=(",", ":"))
iomProfileMoidsJson = json.dumps(iomProfileMoids, separators=(",", ":"))
metadataReady = bool(profileMoid and profileObjectType and profileJson and policyBucketJson and sourceTemplateJson and assignmentJson and configContextJson)

properties.description: Validates all stored JSON collections, combines direct and child-switch policies with Moid de-duplication, and assembles the final profile, assignment, deployment, I/O, and disk-inventory response.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

def load(raw, label):
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError("%s is not valid JSON: %s" % (label, exc))

def dedupe(values):
    answer = []
    seen = set()
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError("Policy collections must contain relationship objects")
        key = value.get("Moid") or json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
        if key not in seen:
